recentItems.title: YEONJUN (연준) “Ice Cream” (Live Performance) | Open Mic
recentItems.description:
YEONJUN (연준) hit the Open Mic stage to perform his hit song “Ice Cream.” You may recognize the South Korean pop star as a member of the K-pop group TOMORROW X TOGETHER, but he’s also found success with his solo career. Bringing his own style and energy to the Open Mic stage, YEONJUN delivers a catchy, hypnotic performance you won’t want to miss!

recentItems.title: BINI “A Parallel World” (Live Performance) | Open Mic
recentItems.description:
BINI made their Genius debut with a performance of their song “A Parallel World.” The track appears on the upcoming DreamWorks movie Forgotten Island soundtrack, centering on friendship and making memories while drawing inspiration from Filipino culture, where the group is from. The group brightens up the Open Mic stage with this feel-good track!
